Source context retained for reconstruction:

This definition **names** the closure invariant. As of 2026-06-23 it is **enacted
in review mode**: a **default-deny catch-all row** was added to the
[AUTHORITY-MODEL Authority Kinds table](../AUTHORITY-MODEL.md#authority-kinds) by
decision-gate ([decision record](../decisions/2026-06-23-authority-kind-closure-catchall-row.md)),
so an unenumerated kind defaults to blocked. The **deterministic** enforcement (the
automated kind-enumeration scan, the former `CAV2-C16` validator) is still pending
(OQ-1). Per the OQ-2 recommendation, the kind-table amendment for `invariant`/`axiom`
as their own kinds stays a future decision-gate call (they currently govern as the
`Definition` kind).

A new *type* of authority can't start governing just because it appeared. Until it
is on the official list of kinds — with its lifecycle and owner — anything of that
kind is blocked.

Scoped to authority **kinds** (the enumeration), not individual artifacts (that is
the Authority Rule, `CAV2-D41`) and not the per-artifact promotion path (`CAV2-D48`
+ the promotion-policy ladder). Promoting this definition did not by itself enact
the kind table as closed-with-default-deny. Review-mode enactment now lives in
the [AUTHORITY-MODEL catch-all row](../AUTHORITY-MODEL.md#authority-kinds);
deterministic enforcement remains pending.
```text
CAKE: Kinds is closed;
for an artifact of kind k,
k in Kinds      -> governed by k's own ladder/owner
k not in Kinds  -> default-deny (blocked) until an owner amends Kinds

```

This **extends** `CAV2-D41` (which assumes a kind/owner exists and says "route to
it") to the case it assumes away — a kind with no enumerated owner/ladder yet.

Closed Authority-Kind Invariant is the normalized invariant identified by semantic.closed-authority-kind-invariant, owned within scope.shared-authority, and carried by type.invariant. Any canonical instance must preserve that classification and the accepted source relations to CAV2-D49 without silently merging it with another target.

Bound source-semantic basis:

Closed authority-kind enumeration is the invariant that the set of authority
**kinds** is a closed enumeration (the `../AUTHORITY-MODEL.md` Authority Kinds
table).

An artifact whose kind is **not** in that enumeration may not acquire or
exercise authority — it defaults to **blocked**

pending an owner decision that adds
the kind to the enumeration with its declared lifecycle (`CAV2-D48`) and owner
route. Adding a kind is itself owner-gated.

counterexamples.scenario: An enumerated kind and a named invariant do not confer instance grants or deterministic enforcement; a proposal without an applied table amendment remains unlisted.

instances.scenario: One selected unknown kind is normatively denied before a qualified registered owner-gated addition; its instances still need their own ladder/owner after membership.

review_packet.intuition: Kind closure blocks unlisted governing types; listed kinds route through their own governance. Definition promotion and review enactment are separate from runtime prevention.

conflicts.description: Normalized wrapper, quoted source basis/CAKE duplicates and historical source admission do not accept this formal interpretation.
Scoped authority-kind membership/closed-world interpretation and all relevant negative evidence need exact table/version/kind/classification maps; other type/Relation Kind vocabularies stay distinct.
Unknown-kind block and permission denial are normative; they do not prove actual prevention/acquisition/exercise or deterministic enforcement.
Registered successor additions require a qualified owner decision, lifecycle and owner route; labels/markers are not authenticated gates, decision sufficiency, automatic unblocking or removal policy.
State/successor registration, byte identity and context coverage lack universal temporal/history semantics; unregistered membership changes and removals remain outside the selected addition rule.
Enumerated kind uses its own ladder/owner; membership does not grant instance authority, admission or deployment.
Definition promotion, review-mode catch-all decision, deterministic scan and separately proposed Axiom/Invariant kind elevation remain separate and unimported.
Authored dependency completeness and shared meaning remain independently unreviewed; current carrier bindings and schema fields do not prove whole semantic enforcement.
